Case 1: \(178XY\): \(10 \cdot 10 = 100\).

Case 2: \(X178Y\), with \(X \neq 0\): \(9 \cdot 10 = 90\).

Case 3: \(XY178\), with \(X \neq 0\): \(9 \cdot 10 = 90\).

No overlaps are possible because the positions of digits in “178” would conflict.

Total:
\[
100 + 90 + 90 = 280
\]

\boxed{280}
